provenance.portal: Sample care-portal export (care-portal.example.com) — schema-true synthetic data
provenance.headline_answer: Every value in the sample dataset is synthetic. In a real deployment this section documents which portal endpoints produced each field.

fields.note: Sample: shows how provenance for the contacts field is documented, including discrepancies.

fields.field: Visits, carer notes, task & medication outcomes (sample)
fields.note: Sample: one row per visit with joined note text.
Sample: dose-level administration rows with gap warnings.

api_scope.question: Is the API able to access information that isn't shown in the portal UI?
api_scope.answer: Sample answer: partly — raw fields (IDs, entry logistics, medication limits) exist beyond the UI, while admin/audit data sits behind staff roles.
not_exposed_to_family_role: Any edit/audit history for profile fields (sample)

change_attribution.question: Can you see who requested that information (e.g. next of kin) was changed?
change_attribution.answer: Sample answer: no change history is exposed to the family role; only login audit events are available.
routes: Ask the agency office in writing for the change history (sample)
Submit a Subject Access Request (UK GDPR Art 15) (sample)
Request rectification (UK GDPR Art 16) via the letter generator (sample)

alex.question: Is the family admin mentioned anywhere in the portal record? (sample)
alex.answer: Sample: the family admin appears in carer notes as the contact for updates but is missing from the contacts list — a common data-quality finding to watch for.

quotes.note: Sample note: phoned son to confirm medication change.
Sample note: son asked for extra tea visit, agreed.

alzheimer.question: Do the data suggest a diagnosis the record never names? (sample)
alzheimer.short_answer: Sample: strong indirect signals (memory-clinic visits, cognitive-impairment risk lines) with no named diagnosis — the classic 'established-but-unrecorded' gap.

signals.detail: Sample: a dementia-specific medication on the active list.
Sample: notes record a memory-clinic nurse visit at home.
Sample: cognitive-impairment entries rated LOW despite strong signals.

alzheimer.verdict: Sample verdict: treat a missing-but-implied diagnosis as a records-quality issue; chase written confirmation and a dementia care plan.
staff_awareness: Sample: staff facilitated memory-clinic involvement (partial awareness).
Sample: no dementia-specific care strategy appears in notes.
actions: Ask the GP to confirm diagnosis and stage in writing (sample)
Ask the agency to re-rate the cognitive-impairment risk assessment (sample)
Request a dementia care plan and staff briefing (sample)

incorrect_info.reality: Sample: the family admin should be the primary next of kin but is absent from the list.
actions: Send a rectification request naming the correct next of kin (sample)

incorrect_info.item: Implied diagnosis missing from the record (sample)
incorrect_info.reality: Sample: medication and care events corroborate a diagnosis the record never names.
incorrect_info.status: GP confirmation requested via letter template

incorrect_info.item: Communication-log endpoint returned another client's entry (sample)
incorrect_info.reality: Sample: data-contamination finding — the portal's communication log cannot be trusted as complete.
incorrect_info.status: Raised with the agency; keep the family-side log
